product_one_liner.value: Rivo is an AI money manager for households that automatically puts idle cash to work and moves money back when bills or transfers are approaching, while working with their existing bank accounts.
product_one_liner.notes: Rivo's FAQ describes the product as designed for households seeking to earn more on idle bank cash, automate bills and loans, and move money between accounts; the one-liner condenses those stated functions. URL: https://www.rivofi.com/faqs

pricing_page.notes: Rivo has a public fee-explainer page that states its actual management fee is 0.05% per month, so a public page with pricing information exists. URL: https://www.rivofi.com/blog/rivo-fees

named_customers.notes: The homepage has testimonial statements but does not name the customers in the cited testimonial section; therefore no names can be listed. URL: https://www.rivofi.com/
